t: 契丹建立的辽朝太宗攻占大梁，结束了后晋王朝的统治。
te: Emperor Taizong of the Khitan-led Liao dynasty captures Daliang, ending the dynasty and empire of the Later Jin.
dz: 契丹建立的辽朝太宗攻占大梁，结束了后晋王朝的统治。
de: Emperor Taizong of the Khitan-led Liao dynasty captures Daliang, ending the dynasty and empire of the Later Jin.

t: 后汉由刘知远所建. 他自称是皇帝.
te: The Later Han is founded by Liu Zhiyuan. He declares himself emperor.
dz: 后汉由刘知远所建. 他自称是皇帝.
de: The Later Han is founded by Liu Zhiyuan. He declares himself emperor.

t: 阿布·亚齐德是一名哈里吉特叛军领导人,被法蒂米德部队在现代阿尔及利亚的霍德纳山脉被击败并杀害.
te: Abu Yazid, a Kharijite rebel leader, is defeated and killed in the Hodna Mountains in modern-day Algeria by Fatimid for…
dz: 阿布·亚齐德是一名哈里吉特叛军领导人,被法蒂米德部队在现代阿尔及利亚的霍德纳山脉被击败并杀害.
de: Abu Yazid, a Kharijite rebel leader, is defeated and killed in the Hodna Mountains in modern-day Algeria by Fatimid forces.
